description:
Be part of something groundbreaking  
 
 At AIG, we are making long-term investments in a brand-new, innovative Generative AI team, designed to explore new possibilities for how artificial intelligence can be applied in insurance and beyond, and we need your help.  
 
 With the support and investment needed to explore new frontiers in generative AI, you’ll be working alongside talented colleagues, innovating and leading projects that will transform how we manage risk and serve our customers.  
 
 This team is central to our vision of the future and the core of our business offering. We will incorporate best-in-class engineering and product management principles, and your guidance and collaboration will be critical to its success.
 
 To rapidly advance and innovate, we need your skills and expertise to build and scale world-class products. If you’re excited by the opportunity to create meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you. 
 
 Who we are  
 
 AIG is a leading global insurance organization providing a wide range of property casualty insurance and other financial services. We provide world-class products and expertise to businesses and individuals in approximately 190 countries and jurisdictions.  
 
 At AIG, we’re reshaping how the world manages risk, and we’re inviting you to be a key part of that transformation. As our Data Scientist you will have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact, leveraging and further developing your skills to guide groundbreaking AI initiatives. If you’re looking for a place to grow your career and where your contributions will shape the future, AIG is where you belong.  
 
 How you will create impact:  
 
 This role is critical to innovation team in AICOE. Through this initiative, we are building a strategic capability to Implement Advanced AI Techniques, including RAG, Knowledge Graph, Agentic design, POC and Model Context Protocol MCP with evaluators to ensure reliability and performance. This role is critical to contribute to the invention in AIG GenAI’s projects and AIG’s Intelligent property, which keeps AIG leading the insurance industry in Gen AI area.
 
 Your responsibilities include:  
 GenAI research and application: Stay up to date with the latest advancements in GenAI and apply this knowledge to develop innovative solutions that drive member and business value. This includes designing and implementing novel architectures, algorithms, and techniques for LLMs, multi-modal models, and other GenAI applications. Be accountable for high-quality data science solutions with respect to accuracy, coverage, scalability, stability, and business adoption

 Agentic system development and optimization: Design and build enterprise level Agentic solution, including data processing and curation, to mitigate biases and ensure high-quality datasets for optimized model performance. Influence efficient Agentic architecture design for optimal performance, efficiency, and scalability

 Research strategy and direction: Define and drive the long-term research vision and strategy for GenAI in the organization, aligning with business objectives and goals. This includes identifying key research areas, setting ambitious goals, and developing achievable milestones. Take ownership of algorithms and drive enhancements/optimizations based on business requirements with proper documentation and code-reusability

 Collaboration and communication: Effectively collaborate with and communicate complex research concepts to cross-functional teams, including engineering, product, and business stakeholders. This includes distilling research findings into actionable insights, providing technical guidance, and influencing the adoption of GenAI solutions

 GenAI thought leader: Advance expertise in GenAI through continuous learning, attending conferences, and engaging with the broader research community. Contribute to the team's knowledge base and advance the field through publications, presentations, and sharing of insights and expertise

 
 What is needed to be successful:  
 Ph.D. with 2+ years’ industry experience

 Design and deploy Agentic AI solutions to automate complex business workflows, enhance decision-making, and improve customer and employee experiences.

 Translate research in agentic AI, reinforcement learning, and reasoning into practical solutions that support underwriting, Operation, claims automation, customer servicing, and risk assessment

 Experience implementing Agentic AI frameworks, such as CrewAI, Claude Agent sdk and LangChain, to build autonomous systems in production settings

 Strong ML, Deep Learning and Gen AI hand-on and scientific research skills

 Have produced novel research related to agentic design and implementation

 Experience in designing and implementing Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers to enable seamless integration between AI agents, enterprise systems, and external tools

 Specialized expertise in other topics like fine-tuning, RLHF, RAG and Knowledge graph etc.

 Experience in designing and implementing Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers to enable seamless integration between AI agents, enterprise systems, and external tools

 Knowledge of Palantir platforms will be plus

 Ph.D. Publication with GenAI and/or Agentic is a plus

 Are passionate about getting your work into the hands of real users and - more broadly - democratizing access to modern AI technology.

 Are motivated by working on Gen AI research that - contrary to the general trend in the field - will be disclosed to the public.

 Strong communication skills and a desire to work on a small, fast-paced team

 
 Veterans are encouraged to apply. 
 
 #LI-RG2 #LI-AIG #AI #GenAI #artificialintelligence #DataScience #BigData 
 
 At AIG, we value in-person collaboration as a vital part of our culture, which is why we ask our team members to be primarily in the office. This approach helps us work together effectively and create a supportive, connected environment for our team and clients alike. 
 
 Enjoy benefits that take care of what matters 
 At AIG, our people are our greatest asset. We know how important it is to protect and invest in what’s most important to you. That is why we created our Total Rewards Program, a comprehensive benefits package that extends beyond time spent at work to offer benefits focused on your health, wellbeing and financial security—as well as your professional development—to bring peace of mind to you and your family.
 
 Reimagining insurance to make a bigger difference to the world 
 American International Group, Inc. (AIG) is a global leader in commercial and personal insurance solutions; we are one of the world’s most far-reaching property casualty networks. It is an exciting time to join us — across our operations, we are thinking in new and innovative ways to deliver ever-better solutions to our customers. At AIG, you can go further to support individuals, businesses, and communities, helping them to manage risk, respond to times of uncertainty and discover new potential. We invest in our largest asset, our people, through continuous learning and development, in a culture that celebrates everyone for who they are and what they want to become.
 
 Welcome to a culture of inclusion 
 We’re committed to creating a culture that truly respects and celebrates each other’s talents, backgrounds, cultures, opinions and goals. We foster a culture of inclusion and belonging through learning, cultural awareness activities and Employee Resource Groups (ERGs). With global chapters, ERGs are a cornerstone for our culture of inclusion. The talent of our people is one of AIG’s greatest assets, and we are honored that our drive for positive change has been recognized by numerous recent awards and accreditations.
 
 AIG provides equal opportunity to all qualified individuals regardless of race, color, religion, age, gender, gender expression, national origin, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected categories. 
 
 AIG is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to job applicants and employees with disabilities.  If you believe you need a reasonable accommodation, please send an email to candidatecare@aig.com .
